project: ReqSys v2 Enterprise — Engineering Control Plane
description: Fila ci:recuperado orientada por eventos: PR CI Watch para transitórios, Ollama/Codex Worker Pool para falhas técnicas elegíveis na mesma branch, sync serial, auto-ready em duas fases, merge por SHA, pós-merge checkpoint/Teams e avanço; sem Work e sem novo workflow.

sdd_gate.evidence_contract: CI failure -> PR CI Watch safe rerun; deterministic technical eligible -> Ollama CI Triage -> Worker Pool same target_branch/base_sha; recovered draft -> serial sync -> green -> ready sem merge -> revalidation -> SHA-protected merge -> post-merge checkpoint/Teams -> next PR dispatch.
